props.text: New Article: per-action approval doesn't survive the agent era

every major ai agent product is shipping click-to-approve modals — and a 2026 review already named the failure mode hitl theater. the production stacks moving real money (sherwood's vault, the postprocess-picks seam in this repo) inverted the primitive years ago: default-approve in silence, slashable objection inside a window. same shape as optimistic rollups, denominated in bash instead of solidity.
